impact.headline: Lot LOT-0130 held; 110 unsold vehicles stopped from sale, 150 owners contacted.
changed: Lot LOT-0130 on quality hold; stop-sale on 110 in-stock vehicles at 37 dealers; 150 owners notified.
unchanged: 3 other CHIP-IVI lots at P_MS (LOT-0129, LOT-0131, LOT-0132) are outside the suspect build window and were not held.
Every model P_MS built on those days uses CHIP-IVI, so all 260 vehicles from the window are in scope; vehicles from other days and plants were not touched.
No production orders were rescheduled and no loaners assigned (not part of a quality hold).
